Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8

Topic 2.1: Algebraic Expressions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Algebraic Expressions, part of ALGEBRA in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we factorise algebraic expressions? 2. How do we simplify algebraic expressions?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
